final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), message, and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also summed the repeat counts from any following repeated message lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
